frozen_contamination_contract.identity_namespace_rule: MFL custom player IDs are league-scoped and must never be treated as globally unique. Custom identities may be matched only with league-scoped metadata plus unambiguous normalized name+position+NFL draft class.
frozen_contamination_contract.league_rule: A league with any positive contamination evidence is excluded from every V4 primary/source-sufficiency scope. Diagnostic unknown identities are reported but are not silently converted into same-year identities.
positive_contamination_evidence: Any resolved standard-player identity in the audited draft scope whose NFL draft class is earlier than the league draft year.
Any resolved standard-player identity in the audited draft scope whose NFL draft class is later than the league draft year.
Any league-scoped custom-player identity that unambiguously maps to an earlier or later NFL draft class.
Any league-scoped custom-player metadata explicitly identifying a Devy player/placeholder.

frozen_search_contract.existing_clean_seed: The positively uncontaminated V3 catalog subset may be carried forward only as source evidence, with V3's stop preserved. It is not a V4 frozen catalog until a later catalog freeze.
frozen_search_contract.new_candidate_priority: Known V3 frozen-catalog league IDs remain auditable seeds; previously unseen IDs from the expanded bounded union are probed next in deterministic order.
frozen_search_contract.ordering: Deterministic SHA-256 ordering by year, search term, and league id.
